properties.name: Luangwa basin above the Zambezi confluence at Zumbo
properties.source_note: SCOPING-MOZ-HYDRO.md's approximate confluence (-15.61, 30.44) lands in the Zambezi mainstem lev-7 basin (UP_AREA ~1,009,000 km2 — absurd for 'Luangwa alone', the DRC build's small-tributary lesson in reverse: too big, not too small). Probed neighbouring lev-7 basins for one whose own UP_AREA reads near the published ~144,000 km2 Luangwa magnitude: HYBAS 1071431480, UP_AREA 149,540 km2, NEXT_DOWN the Zambezi mainstem basin — the Luangwa's own pour-point basin. Outlet nudged 0.02 deg west (-15.61, 30.42) to land inside that polygon; the scoping doc's exact point sits just outside it, on the confluence boundary.
